summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of MOCHI (Fase 0-5). 18/18 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend verified: Beranda with hero/stats/demo banner/mascot, Perpustakaan search (Latin DNA=2, Arab القيافة=2, harakat النَّسَب=2, typo qiyafa finds MCH-2004, nonsense shows empty state w/ 'Tanya MOCHI'), filter chips & reset, mobile bottom-sheet filter button present. Masalah detail renders header+Kartu Sanad (lembaga/forum/moderator-pentashih-perumus 'tidak tercatat', Hijriah dates, Banyuwangi), [ISI DARI SUMBER] placeholders preserved (intentional, not a bug), Kutip toast works ('Sitasi disalin'), Laporkan modal opens with alasan+keterangan+kontak, Bandingkan button on related masalah opens compare view, Pernah dibahas di forum lain panel shown. Lembaga list shows Al-Amien with 'Lembaga Baru' badge. Kitab list renders 20 cards (correct testid: kitab-{slug}). /tanya shows honest stub. /ngawur-xyz-404 shows 404 page. No horizontal overflow at 390px on beranda/perpustakaan/masalah pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: load_dotenv runs before importing app.db which is good; MongoDB indexes created on startup — correct. _id properly excluded in all projections.

routes_aksi.py BOT_UA includes 'preview' — this could incorrectly block legitimate Emergent preview-domain visits if any client UA happens to contain 'preview'. Low risk for current demo but worth noting for production.
routes_publik.py profil_lembaga: computes stats for every other lembaga per request (O(N) in-memory ranking) — fine at 3 lembaga, but will not scale; consider cached ranking.
Rate limit for /api/report (5/min) is bucketed by IP+UA; using same UA across tests requires fresh UA to isolate — current impl is acceptable.
test_credentials: N/A — all endpoints public in Fase 0-5 (auth is Fase 6)
seed_data_creation: No seed changes. Used existing seed (21 masalah, 6 forum, 3 lembaga, 20 kitab). Reports created with 'TEST_' prefixed alasan; may need cleanup in laporan collection but non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_mochi_api.py (pytest, module-scoped session). BASE_URL comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. Known testids on MasalahDetail: tombol-kutip, tombol-bagikan, tombol-laporkan, bandingkan-{slug}, tampilan-bandingkan, modal-laporkan, laporkan-alasan. Kitab list uses data-testid='kitab-{slug}'. For /tanya use substring 'chatbot' or 'sedang disiapkan'.
rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs discovered. All previously-fixed issues (seed sparse index, Arab search, mobile overflow, PanelFilter children, clipboard fallback) remain fixed and verified.
